name: Boiled Lemon Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: chopped suet
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of chopped suet

instructions.text: Mix the suet, bread crumbs, sugar and flour well together
Add the lemon peel, which should be the yellow grated from the outside, and the juice, which should be strained
When these ingredients are well mixed, moisten with the eggs and sufficient milk to make the pudding of the consistency of thick batter
Put it into a well-buttered mold and boil for three and a half hours
Turn it out, strew sifted sugar over and serve warm with the lemon sauce, or not, at pleasure

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix the suet, bread crumbs, sugar and flour well together
2. Add the lemon peel, which should be the yellow grated from the outside, and the juice, which should be strained
3. When these ingredients are well mixed, moisten with the eggs and sufficient milk to make the pudding of the consistency of thick batter
4. Put it into a well-buttered mold and boil for three and a half hours
5. Turn it out, strew sifted sugar over and serve warm with the lemon sauce, or not, at pleasure
